## Questions about our services.

### What is included in full-service association management?
Financial management and monthly reporting, budget and reserve planning, assessment collection, vendor bidding and oversight, preventive maintenance, board meeting support, owner communication, records, and rule administration. The exact scope is written into your management agreement.

### Can we hire CenterPoint for financial management only?
Yes. Self-managed boards can engage us for accounting, collections, budgeting, and monthly reporting while the board keeps handling day-to-day building operations. See [financial management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/services/financial-management).

### Do you manage rental apartments?
No. We manage condominium, HOA, and townhome associations only. We do not manage rental apartments, individual rental properties, or tenant leasing.

### How is the management fee set?
As a flat monthly fee, starting at $20 per unit per month, based on your association’s size, building systems, financial complexity, and service needs. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing).

## Tell us about your association.
Share a few details and we will follow up to schedule a conversation with your board. No cost, no obligation.
